reason: An RSS and Atom subscription plugin that manages feeds, fetches and normalizes entries, and supports OPML import and export for agent-accessible browsing.

summaries.zh: 用于管理 RSS 和 Atom 订阅源、抓取并解析文章内容，以及导入导出 OPML 订阅列表。
summaries.en: Manages RSS and Atom subscriptions, fetches and parses feed entries, and imports or exports OPML subscription lists.

capabilities: Fetches RSS and Atom feeds from configured URLs
Persists subscription lists in plugin settings
Imports and exports OPML subscription data
Can write exported OPML content to a specified file path
Supports an optional proxy for feed requests
